info.title: shipmail API
info.description: API-first email provider for creators, freelancers, and businesses of all sizes.

get.description: List events in a time range for one mailbox's calendar. Set expand=true to return recurring events as individual instances.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Expand recurring events into individual instances.

get.description: Compute open meeting slots for one mailbox from its own calendar. Derived app-side (not a cross-user free/busy lookup).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Step between candidate slot starts in minutes (default = duration).

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA time zone the working window is defined in (default Etc/UTC).

parameters.name: window_start
parameters.description: Start of the daily window, minutes from midnight (default 540).

parameters.name: window_end
parameters.description: End of the daily window, minutes from midnight (default 1020).

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Padding around busy intervals in minutes (default 0).

parameters.name: minimum_notice
parameters.description: Minimum notice before the first slot in minutes (default 0).

get.description: Public health check endpoint. No authentication required.

200.description: API status returned. The status field is maintenance during a planned maintenance window.

post.description: Add a custom domain to your account. After creation, configure DNS records and verify.

get.description: List all domains in your account with cursor-based pagination.

patch.description: Update domain settings such as the catch-all mailbox.

delete.description: Permanently delete a domain and all associated mailboxes.

post.description: Check DNS records for the domain and update verification status. Rate limited to 1 request per minute. For automated setups, subscribe to the domain.verified webhook event instead of polling this endpoint.

get.description: Return all DNS records required by Shipmail and run a live, read-only DNS check. This endpoint does not update the domain's persisted verification state.

200.description: Required DNS records with live diagnostics.

post.description: Search for available domain names to register. Returns availability and pricing information.

keyword.description: Keyword to search for available domains.

post.description: Register a new domain through shipmail. Charges the saved payment method and returns the created Domain object. Requires an active subscription.

years.description: Number of years to register for. Defaults to 1.

201.description: Domain registered, DNS configured, and ready for mailboxes.

402.description: Payment failed or no payment method on file.

403.description: Active subscription required to register domains.

post.description: Create a new mailbox on a verified domain.

get.description: List mailboxes with optional domain filter and cursor-based pagination. Use the returned mailbox object's id field as mailbox_id for mailbox-scoped endpoints.

post.description: Add a manual suspension. Authentication, sending, receiving, and mailbox rules are blocked. Billing and security suspension reasons remain independent.
Remove only the manual suspension. Billing, security, organization reputation, and AWS restrictions are not cleared.

200.description: Mailbox after removing the manual suspension.

post.description: Queue a fail-closed ZIP snapshot of one mailbox. Archived mailboxes reuse their exact current billing snapshot without restoring the mailbox. Poll the returned export until completed.

201.description: Completed export created by reusing a compatible archived snapshot.

get.description: Read one customer mailbox export. Completed exports include a private download URL valid for at most five minutes and never beyond the seven-day export expiry.

patch.description: Configure auto-reply (vacation/out-of-office) for a mailbox. When enabled, incoming emails receive an automatic response.
Set the mailbox spam filter threshold. Lower values are stricter; messages at or above the threshold are moved to junk.
Reset the login password for a mailbox.

get.description: List system and custom folders for a mailbox, including unread and total counts.

post.description: Create a custom folder or subfolder for a mailbox. System folder names are reserved.

patch.description: Rename a custom mailbox folder. System folders cannot be renamed.

delete.description: Delete a custom mailbox folder and its subfolders after moving their messages to Trash. Folders referenced by rules must be removed from rules first.

get.description: List JMAP sending identities for a mailbox.
Fetch server-side inbox rules and available target folders for a mailbox.

put.description: Replace all server-side inbox rules for a mailbox. Call GET first to inspect existing rules and folder IDs.

get.description: List pending and active forwarding destinations for a mailbox.

post.description: Send a confirmation email to a forwarding destination. Forwarding becomes active only after the recipient confirms. Active forwarding keeps a copy in the Shipmail mailbox and excludes messages classified as spam. Repeating this request for a pending destination sends a new confirmation link.

200.description: Forwarding destination created, refreshed, or already active.

delete.description: Remove a pending or active forwarding destination. Active delivery is removed from the mail server before the record is deleted.

post.description: Create a fake inbound message in isolated sandbox storage. This endpoint requires a test API key. It runs the normal inbound threading, rule, and webhook pipeline without delivering mail to any supplied address.

get.description: List messages with cursor-based pagination. Provide mailbox_id, client_reference, or both. client_reference lookup is exact and organization-scoped.

parameters.name: mailbox_id
parameters.description: Filter messages by mailbox ID. Use the id field returned by GET /mailboxes.

parameters.name: client_reference
parameters.description: Exact caller-defined reference. At least one of mailbox_id or client_reference is required.

post.description: Send an email from a mailbox. Provide from (email address) or mailbox_id to identify the sender. Prefer from when you know the mailbox email address; Shipmail resolves it to a mailbox ID. At least one of html or text is required. Total recipients (to + cc + bcc) must not exceed 50. Attachments are base64-encoded, max 20 files, 3 MB per file, 3 MB total.
Reply to a message by its ID. Looks up the message's thread and sends a reply using the same mailbox.

get.description: List message threads for a mailbox with cursor-based pagination.
List all messages in a thread with cursor-based pagination.

200.description: Paginated list of messages in the thread.

post.description: Send a reply within an existing thread. At least one of html or text is required. Total recipients (to + cc) must not exceed 50.
Register a webhook endpoint to receive event notifications. Maximum 10 webhooks per account. The secret is only returned at creation time.

201.description: Webhook created. The secret field is only included in this response.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Only returned at creation time.

post.description: Generate a new signing secret. The previous secret remains valid for 24 hours.
Send a test webhook.test event to the endpoint.

get.description: List delivery attempts for a webhook with optional status and event type filters.
Retrieve one organization- and webhook-scoped delivery, including its payload and replay source.

post.description: Create a new pending delivery with the same event ID, event type, and payload. Only failed deliveries using the current webhook contract can be replayed.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of email addresses that have been suppressed for your organization. Addresses are suppressed automatically on hard bounces and complaints, or manually via the dashboard.

delete.description: Removes an email address from the suppression list, allowing you to send to it again. Use with caution: if the address is invalid, future sends will bounce and damage your reputation.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address to remove from the suppression list.

get.description: List inbound JMAP messages for a mailbox with folder, keyword, search, and position-based pagination filters. Rows include body parts and attachment metadata.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: Filter messages to a specific mailbox folder ID.

parameters.name: folder_role
parameters.description: Filter messages by a system folder role. Use either folder_id or folder_role, not both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of messages to return (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: has_keyword
parameters.description: Return messages that have this JMAP keyword.

parameters.name: not_keyword
parameters.description: Return messages that do not have this JMAP keyword.

patch.description: Set read and/or starred state on one inbound JMAP message for a mailbox.

delete.description: Permanently delete one inbound JMAP message. The message must already be in Trash or Junk; use the move endpoint to move it to Trash first.

post.description: Move one inbound JMAP message to a system folder role or custom folder ID.

get.description: Fetch full inbound JMAP thread messages for a mailbox, including body parts and attachment metadata.
Download a raw attachment blob from a mailbox inbox message. Blob IDs are query parameters because they can contain slash characters.

parameters.name: blob_id
parameters.description: JMAP attachment blob ID from an inbox thread response.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Suggested download filename. Defaults to attachment.

post.description: Import mail from another provider into this mailbox. IMAP sources run over the source provider's IMAP with an app password. File sources import staged uploads (Google Takeout MBOX, Proton or Tuta EML exports, generic MBOX or EML zips). The import runs in the background, preserves folders, read state, and dates, deduplicates, and can be re-run safely.

409.description: An import is already running for this mailbox.

get.description: List recent imports for a mailbox, newest first.

post.description: Create a presigned upload for a mailbox export file. PUT the raw file bytes to upload_url, then pass file_id to createMailboxImport with a files source. Staged files that are never used are deleted after 24 hours.

get.description: Fetch one import with live progress counters and the per-folder report.

post.description: Cancel a running import. Mail already imported stays in the mailbox. Starting a new import later resumes without duplicates.
Queue deletion of messages created by an import. Mail that already existed in the mailbox is not touched.
Create a newsletter audience. consent_source is a required consent attestation.

204.description: Audience deleted. Subscribers cascade; newsletters keep their history.

post.description: Add one subscriber (single opt-in). Returns a per-row outcome; it does not error for a suppressed or invalid address. Re-adding an existing subscriber merges: a provided display_name replaces the stored one (absent keeps it), merge_fields keys you send are merged into the stored object, and consent is re-attested. Use PATCH to replace fields wholesale.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter to an exact email address.

post.description: Add up to 1000 subscribers in one call (single opt-in). Returns a per-row outcome for each address, in input order. Net-new admissions are all-or-nothing against the monthly ingest quota: if the remaining quota cannot admit every net-new address in the batch, they are all returned as skipped_quota.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: URL-encoded email address of the subscriber.

patch.description: Update display name or merge fields. To unsubscribe, use the unsubscribe endpoint.

204.description: Subscriber deleted. Prefer unsubscribe to preserve opt-out history.

post.description: Unsubscribe a subscriber. Writes an organization-wide opt-out so future newsletters skip them.
Resubscribe a subscriber after renewed opt-in. Removes their organization-wide newsletter opt-out and marks them active again.
Create a draft newsletter. Drafts must be tested and pass preflight before scheduling.

get.description: List configured newsletter sending domains. Use these IDs as newsletter_domain_id when creating newsletter drafts.

200.description: Paginated list of newsletter sending domains.

patch.description: Update an editable draft newsletter or a scheduled newsletter whose send time is still in the future. Sending and sent newsletters cannot be edited.

post.description: Creates the isolated organization and emails an ownership invitation. Domains and mailboxes are provisioned separately after ownership acceptance.

200.description: Existing organization returned for an idempotent replay.

post.summary: Suspend outbound sending for an operator

200.description: Sending suspended; inbound mail and storage continue.
Consolidated current-month usage and projected charge in cents.

bearerAuth.description: API key authentication. Keys are prefixed with sm_live_ or sm_test_.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Number of items to return (1-100, default 25).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key for idempotent requests. Printable ASCII, 1-255 characters. Cached for 24 hours.

DelegatedOrganizationId.name: X-ShipMail-Organization-Id
DelegatedOrganizationId.description: Invite-only partner beta. Selects an active operator organization on paths that include this parameter. Requires partner:organizations:access and the endpoint's normal scope. Message content, credentials, exports, billing, and account routes do not accept delegated access.

minutes_before.description: Minutes before the event start to fire an email reminder.

start.description: Timed events: a UTC instant. All-day events: a YYYY-MM-DD date.

end.description: Timed events: a UTC instant. All-day events: the exclusive end date.

timezone.description: The event's own IANA time zone. Null for all-day or floating events.

recurrence_id.description: Set on an expanded recurrence instance.

calendar_id.description: Target calendar. Defaults to the mailbox's default calendar.

start.description: Local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Its zone is given by timezone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the start is defined in.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT1H. Defaults to one hour.

UpdateCalendarEventRequest.description: Omitted fields are left unchanged. A null value clears description, location, video_url, recurrence, or reminders.

mailbox.description: The mailbox whose availability the page exposes.

window_start_minutes.description: Start of the daily window, minutes from midnight.

window_end_minutes.description: End of the daily window, minutes from midnight.

conferencing_provider.description: Opt-in provider used to create a meeting for each booking. Null means no meeting link. The provider must already be connected to the page's mailbox, or the request is rejected.

mailbox.description: The mailbox whose availability the page exposes.

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

conferencing_provider.description: Opt-in provider used to create a meeting for each booking. Null or omission means no meeting link. The provider must already be connected to the page's mailbox, or the request is rejected.

UpdateBookingPageRequest.description: Partial update. Provide at least one field.

conferencing_provider.description: Opt-in provider used to create a meeting for each booking. Set null to disable meeting links. The provider must already be connected to the page's mailbox, or the request is rejected.

oneOf.description: Email address as a string. Accepts plain address ("user@example.com") or display name format ("Jane Doe <user@example.com>").

Recipient.description: Email recipient. Either an object with address and optional name, or a string.

managed_by.description: Whether the domain is managed externally or registered through Shipmail.

dmarc_verified.description: Whether the DMARC record was last seen as valid.

dmarc_managed_externally.description: True if a non-shipmail DMARC record is already published for this domain.

registration.description: Registration details for domains registered through shipmail. Null for externally managed domains.

host.description: DNS host relative to the domain. @ means the root domain.

value.description: Expected value. Null only while the DKIM value is pending.

priority.description: MX priority, or null for TXT records.

found_values.description: Values observed during the live DNS check.

purchase_price.description: Purchase price in the specified currency. Null if unavailable.

renewal_price.description: Annual renewal price. Null if unavailable.

suspended_at.description: When the mailbox was suspended. Null if active.

suspension_reasons.description: Independent reasons currently keeping the mailbox suspended.

spam_filter_threshold.description: Spam score threshold for moving messages to junk. Lower is stricter.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID for subfolders, or null for a root folder.

stop.description: When true, later rules are not evaluated after this rule matches.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID for subfolders, or null for a root folder.

ClientReference.description: Caller-defined idempotent correlation reference, unique within an organization.

MessageMetadata.description: Up to 20 scalar values and 8 KB of JSON. Nested objects and arrays are rejected.

SourceRfcMessageId.description: Caller-selected source RFC Message-ID. Its domain must equal the actual sender domain.

DataMode.description: The API-key data plane that owns this resource. Test resources are isolated from live delivery, quota, suppression, and reputation.

SandboxOutcome.description: Synthetic final outcome for a sandbox send. Only accepted with a test API key.

name.description: List-Unsubscribe, List-Unsubscribe-Post, or a non-reserved X-* header.

OutboundHeaders.description: Safe outbound headers. Shipmail, SES, routing, and identity headers are rejected. RFC 8058 requires List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click and an HTTPS List-Unsubscribe URL.

source_rfc_message_id.description: Source RFC Message-ID supplied by the caller or observed before relay.

delivered_rfc_message_id.description: Exact provider-assigned delivered RFC Message-ID after Shipmail observes it in a recipient reply. Null before an observation and never reconstructed from the SES provider ID.

attachments.description: Attachment metadata (filename, size, content_type). Null if no attachments.

scheduled_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 time when a scheduled message should be sent. Null for immediate messages.

payload.description: The exact versioned webhook envelope sent to the endpoint.

records.description: Verification status for each DNS record type.

dmarc_valid.description: Whether a DMARC record exists and parses as a valid policy.

dmarc_exact_match.description: Whether the published DMARC record exactly matches shipmail's recommended record.

dmarc_record_value.description: The DMARC TXT record currently published for the domain, if any.

dmarc_managed_externally.description: True if a non-shipmail DMARC record is already published for this domain.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: When the previous secret stops being accepted (24-hour grace period).

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Null if no more results.

has_more.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

catch_all_mailbox_id.description: Mailbox ID to receive catch-all email, or null to disable.

domain_id.description: ID of the domain for this mailbox.

address.description: Local part of the email address (e.g. hello for hello@example.com).

password.description: Initial mailbox password. Must include lowercase, uppercase, and numeric characters; common passwords are rejected. It is never returned by the API. Delegated partner requests cannot set this field.

generate_password.description: Generate a strong primary password on the server and never return it. Required for delegated partner mailbox provisioning; the operator can later set their own password.

display_name.description: Display name, or null to clear.

name.description: Custom folder name. Reserved system folder names and path separators are rejected.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID for a subfolder, or null to create a root folder.

name.description: New custom folder name. Reserved system folder names and path separators are rejected.

password.description: New mailbox login password. Must be 8-128 characters and include lowercase, uppercase, and numeric characters.

body.description: Reply message text. Required when enabled is true.

threshold.description: Spam score threshold for moving messages to junk. Lower is stricter.

SendMessageRequest.description: Request body for sending a message. Provide either from or mailbox_id to identify the sending mailbox.

from.description: Email address of the sending mailbox. Shipmail resolves it to a mailbox ID server-side.

mailbox_id.description: ID of the sending mailbox. Alternative to from.

html.description: HTML body. At least one of html or text is required.

text.description: Plain text body. At least one of html or text is required.

attachments.description: File attachments. Base64-encoded. Max 20 attachments, 3 MB per file, 3 MB total.

scheduled_at.description: Optional UTC ISO 8601 time to send later. Past or near-immediate times are sent immediately.

html.description: HTML body. At least one of html or text is required.

text.description: Plain text body. At least one of html or text is required.

scheduled_at.description: Optional UTC ISO 8601 time to send this reply later.

text.description: Plain text body. At least one of text or html is required.

html.description: HTML body. At least one of text or html is required.

description.description: Human-readable description, or null to clear.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for the validation detail when available.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (present on 429 responses).

download_path.description: Path relative to the API base URL for downloading this attachment.

UpdateInboxMessageRequest.description: Provide at least one field to set on the message.

read.description: Set whether the message is read.

starred.description: Set whether the message is starred.

MoveInboxMessageRequest.description: Provide exactly one target: target_role or target_folder_id.

from_folder_id.description: Current folder ID. Optional; Shipmail can infer it from the message.

target_role.description: System folder role to move the message to.

target_folder_id.description: Custom folder ID to move the message to.

status.description: paused_throttle means the source provider's daily download limit was reached; the import resumes automatically at resume_at. paused_quota means the destination mailbox is out of storage.

folders.description: Per-folder progress. Returned by getMailboxImport only.

provider.description: Outlook imports require the dashboard's Sign in with Microsoft and cannot be started via the API.

password.description: App password (preferred) or IMAP password. Encrypted at rest, used only for this import, and deleted when it finishes.

file_ids.description: File IDs from POST /mailboxes/{id}/imports/files, uploaded first.

folders.description: Source folder paths to import. Null or omitted imports everything.

file_name.description: Name of the export file (.mbox, .mbox.gz, .zip, or .eml).

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. Up to 4 GB per file.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL. PUT the raw file bytes to this URL, then create the import.

MergeFields.description: Arbitrary string/number/boolean/null values keyed by field name. Max 50 keys.

SubscriberResult.description: Per-row outcome. email_address echoes the normalized (trimmed, lowercased) address. Skip reasons are generic and never reveal suppression or opt-out state.

consent_source.description: Where and how these people opted in. Required consent attestation.
Where and how this subscriber opted in again.

blocks.description: Structured blocks this draft was authored from. body_html and body_text are rendered from these blocks on every draft save. Null for newsletters sent before blocks existed.

body_html.description: Rendered email HTML, derived from blocks for drafts. Read-only.

body_text.description: Plain-text body, derived from blocks unless a manual override was set. Read-only.

body_html.description: Full HTML body. Stored as one custom_html block when blocks are not provided.

body_text.description: Plain-text body. Becomes paragraph blocks when blocks are not provided. With blocks or body_html, sets the plain-text override.

blocks.description: Preferred body format. ShipMail stores blocks and renders body_html and body_text from them. Public API block prose fields are plain text on input.

body_html.description: Full HTML body. Stored as one custom_html block when blocks are not provided.

body_text.description: Plain-text body. Becomes paragraph blocks when blocks are not provided. With blocks or body_html, sets the plain-text override.

blocks.description: Preferred body format. ShipMail stores blocks and renders body_html and body_text from them. Public API block prose fields are plain text on input.

body.description: Plain-text paragraph body. Newlines are converted to paragraph and line breaks.
Plain-text callout body. Newlines are converted to paragraph and line breaks.

url.description: Absolute http, https, or mailto URL.

link_url.description: Optional absolute http, https, or mailto image link.

caption_url.description: Optional absolute http, https, or mailto caption link.

video_url.description: Absolute hosted video URL. Emails render this as a linked thumbnail.

body.description: Plain-text column body. Newlines are converted to paragraph and line breaks.

cta_url.description: Optional http, https, or mailto call-to-action URL.

body.description: Plain-text column body. Newlines are converted to paragraph and line breaks.

cta_url.description: Optional http, https, or mailto call-to-action URL.

url.description: Absolute http, https, or mailto URL.

description.description: Optional description shown under the link.

body.description: Plain-text quote body. Newlines are converted to paragraph and line breaks.

NewsletterBlock.description: Structured newsletter block. Public API block prose fields are plain text on input; ShipMail renders blocks to email-safe HTML and text.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the window resets.

tags.name: Mailboxes
tags.description: Create and manage mailboxes on your domains.

tags.name: Threads
tags.description: View and reply to email threads.

tags.name: Newsletters
tags.description: Create, test, and schedule newsletter campaigns.

tags.name: Partner Beta
tags.description: Invite-only operator organization lifecycle, delegated infrastructure, and consolidated usage. Commercial terms require a signed partner agreement.
